events.verdict: Green (GSW) and Gafford (DAL) come together as they pursue the loose ball, and the contact is marginal.
Porzingis (GSW) moves through Marshall's (DAL) space and dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Green (GSW) cleanly blocks Flagg's (DAL) shot attempt. Any ensuing arm contact from Porzingis (GSW) that occurs after the shot is blocked by Green is deemed incidental.
Washington (DAL) extends his hands into Porzingis (GSW) and delivers contact that affects his FOM off-ball.
Santos (GSW) and Christie (DAL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Flagg (DAL) is bracing for the contact from Santos (GSW) and he releases away from the contact.
Porzingis (GSW) establishes himself in Christie's (DAL) path prior to the contact.
Porzingis (GSW) and Christie (DAL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Santos (GSW) deflects the ball away from Thompson (DAL).
Green (GSW) gathers the ball on his right foot, establishing his left as his pivot, which he maintains prior to releasing the pass.
Flagg (DAL) deflects the ball away from Santos (GSW).

As Marshall (DAL) gathers the ball on his left foot, he momentarily loses control of the ball.  Marshall then regains control of the ball without resuming his dribble and legally passes the ball to his teammate.
Washington (DAL) and Porzingis (GSW) come together at the same spot off-ball and the contact is marginal.
Green (GSW) establishes himself in Flagg's (DAL) path prior to the contact.
Flagg (DAL) initiates contact with Moody's (GSW) lower body while he is airborne, and the contact affects his follow-through.
Washington (DAL) contests Porzingis' (GSW) shot attempt, and the contact after the release is marginal.
Santos (GSW) and Flagg (DAL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Green (GSW) remains in bounds while he is in contact with the ball.
Washington (DAL) cleanly ties up Green (GSW) and a jump ball is correctly assessed.
Marshall (DAL) and Payton II (GSW) come together at the same spot in the air, and the contact is marginal.
